topic: Star at the center of our solar system
core_question: What is the name of the star at the center of our solar system? (secondary: Which metal is the most abundant in Earth's crust?)
answer_summary: Correct answer is the Sun, the star our solar system orbits.; after the topic shift: Correct answer is aluminum (aluminium), the most abundant metallic element in Earth's crust (~8%).
